new_coverage.persistence: 123 checks: actual preparation/cancellation/release; exact member stock and key sets; empty and casualty inventories; parked domains; v1/v2 and mixed-version retry migration including engineers; validation without mutation; backup recovery; blocked corruption; actual failed writes; frozen outcome and exact retry.
new_coverage.campaign_flow: 29 checks: actual Battle input, atlas withdrawal/scene transitions, isolated disk reload/startup, victory, defeat and retry. Terminal outcomes are controlled for lifecycle coverage; no mission-balance result is claimed.
new_coverage.harbor_defense: 57 checks: authored Harbor terrain, concurrent same-section dig/throw/cover and real supporting fire, finite frag/smoke effects and optical expiry, physical useful reserve service/return, exact inventories, one paid upgrade with interruption/resume and exclusive claims on every full tick.

encounter.fixture_initialization: Both headless and native start from populated Harbor initialization and retain monotonic IDs. Initial forces and strategic clocks are controlled; later movement, shooting, work, service, costs and world effects use the normal executors.

initial_native_setup_correction.failed_checkpoint: Successful sustained reserve delivery and return did not complete in the first native setup.
initial_native_setup_correction.diagnosis: The earlier headless fixture began with fresh unit IDs while native Battle retained populated Harbor IDs. ID-staggered defensive review changed the combat sequence; the reserve withdrew under ordinary casualty pressure before completing service.
initial_native_setup_correction.correction: The shared fixture now constructs the same populated Harbor world before replacing forces, and permits the requesting engineer to provide normal protective fire when the opposing section is released. No production mechanics, health, work progress, supply or success thresholds were changed to obtain the result.
initial_native_setup_correction.snapshot_correction: The native wrapper also deep-copies historical member inventories and support dictionaries so later ticks cannot rewrite earlier capture metadata.
initial_native_setup_correction.note: Retained locally as a setup diagnostic. This is not an identical-test negative control or evidence of a production support regression.

native_review.review: All eight captures inspected; root also inspected concurrent roles, live smoke and completed reinforced cover. Software-rendered functional/native review only.
